title: Email Limit Boost
text:
## Email Limit Boost
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099952
Is your membership community growing faster than expected? All Website Plans are allocated 1,500 daily email sends (45,000 free emails each month – for life). The Email Limit Boost removes the 1,500 daily limit and increases your total monthly send limit.
Perfect for Websites That:
Frequently reach the free 1,500 daily limit
Send newsletters to all members and email subscribers
Have high activity levels resulting in a large volume of notification emails
Need to accommodate business growth and reach larger audiences
Visit our website: Email Limit Boost
On the website use the slider to ADD to the email limit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185654461/original/-xrOdZEQFEy4rjro2I0h25eLitVy50uIaA.png?1790170897 | alt: ]
Use the " Add (5,000,10,000,15,000,...) Emails ($x/Mo) " button to increase the limit:

## How Billing Works for Email Limit Boosts
When you purchase an email limit boost, the sending limit for that site increases immediately for the current calendar month. Example: An email limit boost purchased on June 1st or June 29th will both apply through June 30th. On July 1st, the limits will renew and reset based on the total number of email limit boosts purchased and billed for that month.
